scenicChapters.title: Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2474 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 35 km this is Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

timmelsjoch-high-alpine-road.story: A 57 km one-way ride from near Sölden, about 59 min of riding. It goes by way of Timmelsjoch and Pass Museum. The highest point is about 2,450 m. Timmelsjoch is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Austria into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
